entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 provides a universal memory layer for AI agents that supports multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states. Available as a managed cloud service or Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, it utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to manage persistent information.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent information using a viking:// URI virtual filesystem. It employs a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption by 91% while extracting user preferences and agent experiences into long-term memory.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data, supporting memory storage, retrieval, and session distillation for Python-based environments.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores explicit facts with provenance and enables cross-agent availability of information. It features a synthesis layer for cited prose and extracts typed entity edges to facilitate graph-based knowledge retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine that achieves sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for external platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that extracts conclusions from conversation history to provide reasoning-first memory. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and supports managed hosting, local CLI execution, or self-hosting via Docker.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli treats memory as a git repository, using an Elastic License 2.0 and a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and provides git-like version control, including commits and branches, for managing a markdown context tree.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that utilizes SQLite for local storage to ensure sub-millisecond performance without cloud reliance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and allows agents to store facts with specific importance levels and expiry dates.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage agent persistence. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki via local Docker infrastructure.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data in the filesystem. It executes tasks through iterations to retain lessons and artifacts, supporting integration via Python, TypeScript, and MCP.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a SQLite store and a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for message persistence. It includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to ensure that no message or detail is lost during agent operations.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past interactions. It processes up to 5 GB of history while redacting keys and tokens during the indexing phase.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to maintain private cross-session memory using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers and any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for persistent state management.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process, achieving 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur uses a shared memory layer based on an open engram YAML format to ensure local ownership of plain-text memory files. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding search for local-first retrieval across MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and vector search, integrating directly via MCP and agent hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This SQLite-backed system uses a five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embedding models. It offers a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes LLM inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to increase prefix reuse, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It includes native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to save up to 36% in token usage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching why_retrieved tags to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It relies on local embedding models and hybrid search without using telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It manages state and retrieval to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs using SQLite-vec and local GGUF models. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files before the context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking via MCP-native integration.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing semantic search through BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead via local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings during native tool search operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores identity, decisions, and workflows in plain Markdown files for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It employs a source-neutral migration workflow to manage context across chats and documents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships, with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion and utilizes an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log of every memory operation to ensure transparency in prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables AI agents to pay for services using USDC and stablecoins across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana. It settles payments directly to wallets with 0% fees and verifies transactions locally against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers using tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports the automatic generation of tool routing notes through model calls to index local capabilities.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval performance.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for search, synchronization, and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filters and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using hybrid search that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a git-backed, file-based system for managing agent memory through versioned markdown directories rather than a database. It features specialized curators to identify stale or conflicting data and uses five slash commands to facilitate the capture, recall, and review of evidence-cited memory diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework enables autonomous task execution through a subagent-driven development process. It integrates with various coding harnesses to enforce test-driven development and YAGNI principles during software implementation.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system supports 26 CLI executables, including Hermes, to generate prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews. Users can export design projects into multiple formats such as HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: Compatible with over 26 AI platforms, this library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains. It maps these capabilities to major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, ATLAS, and D3FEND.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also utilizes Diagram-as-Test and YAML/JSON rules to enforce architecture contracts.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions, payments, and escrow. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes and agentskills.io agents, offering rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into an evolving collective library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for the inspection of skills and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for agents following agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and include ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables secure agent operations through sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host system.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models and offers Lite and Full modes to match project complexity.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This tool implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first harness that uses SQLite and Git for session storage and structured memory. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team workflows through Markdown-based recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It provides a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports specific integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams within the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically in Portuguese. All resources follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API. The package includes a specialized router to direct requests to dedicated video generation agents and supports webhook-based polling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This utility generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from existing codebases, documentation, and developer discourse. It manages the skill lifecycle by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation. It features recursive dependency resolution and supports commercial skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a four-verb .nika.yaml file format and a Rust binary. It supports local-first execution and includes a check command to audit task dependencies and estimated costs.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill facilitates autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system for Hermes Agent that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. It is designed to reduce token usage and offers graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This ADHD-friendly personal execution system allows Hermes Agent to manage habits, study blocks, and scheduling via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by deploying three parallel subagents to analyze code for edge cases and integration issues. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan with tools like Semgrep and Bandit, verifying findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages via langid integration and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this multi-agent skill uses Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code in languages such as TypeScript, Python, and Rust. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for Hermes, including multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address real exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering to compression, ensuring output files remain under 8 MB for optimal embedding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first observability dashboard that provides real-time monitoring across 11 tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing specification rot. It validates skills against runtime profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify and propose coverage gaps for AI agent skills. It gates all updates behind a multi-layered evaluation framework and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible Python runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards to facilitate machine-to-machine transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides functional quality certification by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and offers a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for managing bounty boards, purchasing context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured summaries with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: A collection of specialized tools for Chinese-language tasks, including Douyin video transcription and macOS-based document OCR. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that indexes code symbols and callers to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates the index upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for data visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 35 AI coding tools. It synchronizes data across multiple devices and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize their CLI experience.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM and GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports environments including LangGraph, CrewAI, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin integrates MemOS memory storage with Hermes, supporting semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It facilitates remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms while providing 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers a visual workflow builder with human approval gates and scheduled jobs for Hermes and other agent runtimes. It provides unified configuration for 10 platforms, including WhatsApp and WeChat, alongside usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog with a full file browser and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent to expand its multi-agent capabilities.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, complemented by native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process control.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes gateways. It features a Bot Mode for thread management and an Assist tool for site-aware drafting across 31 writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a web server to enable real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based interface functions as a consciousness monitor featuring nine interactive tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote environment management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard operates as a Telegram Mini App with support for dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It enables terminal chat with file attachments and can spawn up to five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This zero-install Windows desktop solution runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for real-time log streaming and chat interactions. It combines a file browser and task tracking dashboard with management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a native interface for model switching and streaming responses.
